conditions: This applies to the file-loading and Lisp-buffer evaluation contexts described in the reference manual.
limitations: Special variables have their own dynamic binding rule. Direct eval calls, command-line evaluation and interactive evaluation have separately documented controls.

triggers: Exact publisher representation changed, source correction, or contrary language or edition evidence.

statement: When GNU Emacs 29.4 loads an Emacs Lisp file or evaluates a Lisp buffer, a non-nil buffer-local lexical-binding value enables lexical binding for eligible variables. A nil value selects dynamic binding for local variables.
